## What's new

- Duplicate scene merges now combine descriptive metadata. Populated keeper values take priority, empty keeper fields are filled from sources, and multi-value fields such as performers, tags, galleries, groups, URLs, and Stash IDs are deduplicated.
- Preview shows the planned metadata with its source, the selected cover image, and what will happen to source files.

## Fixes

- When the keeper has no usable cover, the merge copies the first available source cover. Stash's default SVG placeholder is ignored.
- When the keeper has no media file or its file cannot be reached, transferred source files are preserved. An available transferred file becomes the primary file when needed.
- Source files are deleted only when the keeper's media file is available.

Use **PREVIEW** to inspect a merge before applying it. Merging still removes the source scene records, and it can delete source media when the keeper file is available.
